description: This file defines the ImpactDataProject class, which models the association between ImpactData and Project entities, providing methods for retrieving, managing, and persisting impact data related to projects, including calculations and database interactions.

classes.name: ImpactDataProject
classes.description: A model class representing the impact data associated with a specific project, with database persistence and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ImpactDataProject instance, loading associated ImpactData and Project entities if identifiers are set.

methods.name: setImpactData
methods.description: Sets the ImpactData object for this ImpactDataProject.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Sets the Project object for this ImpactDataProject.

methods.name: getByProjectAndImpactData
methods.description: Retrieves an ImpactDataProject instance matching a specific project and impact data.

methods.name: getListByProject
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ImpactDataProjects associated with a specific project.

methods.name: getCalculatedListByProject
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ImpactDataProjects with calculated estimation amounts for a specific project, aggregating costs.

methods.name: getListByProjectAndFootprint
methods.description: Retrieves ImpactDataProjects associated with a specific project and footprint.

methods.name: getCalculatedByProjectAndFootprint
methods.description: Retrieves ImpactDataProjects with calculated estimation amounts for a project and footprint.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of ImpactDataProjects for a given project.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific impact data exists for a project.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the ImpactDataProject instance to the database, with validation.
